strategic_capability_mapping.relationship: Recoverable failed patch_file apply evidence can admit a replay-safe recovery task and run it to a recovery proposal review boundary.
The recovery proposal still goes through existing workspace.write proposal validation and explicit proposal.apply remains the only mutation path.
Recovery admission requires explicit authorization, matching source apply/failure fingerprints, recoverable failure class, and existing mode policy before task/proposal state changes.
Recovery provenance records bounded source run/proposal/apply ids, fingerprints, failure class, hunk count, and hunk fingerprint without raw content.

answers.strategic_capabilities: Advances headless_autonomous_development with supporting controlled_workspace_tools, runtime_permission_enforcement, and persistent_structured_ledger.
answers.new_capability: A recoverable failed patch_file apply result can create or replay one runtime-owned recovery task and one recovery-scoped patch_file proposal.
answers.why_existing_functionality_is_insufficie: M25.1 and M26.1 fail closed on stale or mismatched patch apply evidence but do not admit recovery state from that evidence.
answers.product_gap_if_skipped: Headless callers must implement patch apply recovery policy outside Rust after common stale hunk/hash failures.
answers.non_duplicative: Yes. M26.1 added multi-hunk patch apply, M25.1 added single-hunk patch apply, and M24.2 handled delete transaction recovery apply; this phase adds one-file patch apply failure recovery to proposal review.
answers.no_new_rpc: Yes. Existing task.start and task.run are extended with bounded recovery source and outcome fields.
answers.no_new_summary: Yes. Bounded recovery metadata is tied to task/proposal state transitions, not a standalone report surface.
answers.runtime_behavior_change: The runtime validates patch apply failure evidence, creates/replays a recovery task, revalidates source evidence at run time, and marks recovery-scoped patch proposals.
answers.headless_autonomous_contribution: Scheduled callers can move from stale patch apply failure evidence to an explicit proposal review boundary without caller-owned recovery policy.
answers.milestone_progress: Establishes M27 core recovery admission/proposal capability; follow-on headless routing may remain.

review_value_gate.review_intent: M27.1 must be reviewed for actual patch apply recovery task/proposal state transitions, replay safety, source fingerprint checks, and bounded evidence.

guard_engine_change_review.review_intent: M27.1 changes the current phase manifest only; guard engine changes are not expected.

exit_criteria: task.start accepts bounded patch_apply_recovery_source evidence and creates or replays one recovery task for a latest recoverable failed patch_file apply result
task.run on that recovery task revalidates source apply evidence before execution and creates or replays one recovery-scoped patch_file proposal
mismatched source apply fingerprint, failure fingerprint, operation, missing authorization, unsupported failure class, or stale evidence rejects before recovery state changes
recovery proposal evidence stores only bounded source ids, fingerprints, failure class, hunk count, and hunk fingerprint
recovery admission and task execution do not mutate workspace files; proposal.apply remains explicit

tests: creates a task.start patch apply recovery request

next_phase_candidate_notes: After M27.1 merges, consider headless.continue_once routing across patch apply recovery admission/run boundaries without automatic apply.
